messages.subject: R-GSOC 2022 wiki created
parts: Hi all, R-GSOC 2021 projects have been announced. If you had a project idea this year that did not work out for whatever reason, feel free to copy it over to the wiki for next year, which I just created https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2022/wiki/table%20of%20proposed%20coding%20projects
